findings.quote: He set the blank on the counter beside her, square to the edge. He did not offer to recopy it. He did not suggest they settle it between them.

findings.reference: bible/characters.md register notes: Brandt softens by describing paperwork; the restraint should read as withheld, not mechanical
findings.arbitration: UPHELD: quote present verbatim; three identical shapes in a row is a listed minor
